prompt:
This file is prompt-only policy for Seed delegation. Do not add API tools, change seed.sh, or write a wrapper or scheduler.

A Seed child is one command: seed --oneshot '<self-contained task>'. It inherits SEED_HOME and provenance, loads saved provider configuration itself, and writes evidence under .agent-runs/ in its cwd. Never print or pass an API key in the command. If seed is absent from the frozen PATH, ask the human to run /ini.

A child cannot see this conversation. Include exact cwd, in-scope paths, the bounded task, off-limits paths, and acceptance commands. One level only: the child must not delegate again. Do not delegate a small task.

Short work may run synchronously. Work that can exceed the shell timeout runs in the background with stdout and stderr redirected to files; poll evidence or the recorded process without treating liveness alone as semantic completion. Parallel children need non-overlapping files.

An ok host-agent CLI in Machine index capabilities may carry a bounded task when its recorded use and scope fit better. Resources are not callable until installed and verified into capabilities.

Done requires one real, short delegation: read its final response and verify a new non-init evidence directory containing messages, usage, and provenance. Otherwise leave ours.seed_agent.delegate unset.
